episodes.title: Extraordinary Attorney Woo
episodes.summary: On her first day at a new job, Woo Young-woo meets an ally, a skeptic and an old acquaintance. She takes on an assault case involving an elderly couple.

episodes.title: The Wedding Dress That Slipped Off
episodes.summary: The father of a bride sues a hotel for a wedding that ended in a humiliating disaster. Lee Jun-ho asks Young-woo to share her whale facts over lunch.

episodes.title: This is Pengsoo
episodes.summary: A tragedy surrounding two brothers forces a family to face a difficult truth. Young-woo attempts to bridge a communication gap with a client.

episodes.title: The Strife of the Three Brothers
episodes.summary: Dong Geu-ra-mi seeks legal advice from Young-woo when her father unknowingly agrees to take on a massive debt. Kwon Min-woo broods in resentment.

episodes.title: Wild Card VS Tactician
episodes.summary: A copyright battle between two ATM companies stokes a rivalry between Young-woo and Min-woo. Geu-ra-mi teaches Young-woo how to spot a liar.

episodes.title: If I Were a Whale...
episodes.summary: Young-woo joins Choi Su-yeon in her mission to reunite a mother with her daughter. They explore every avenue to reduce a four-year sentence.

episodes.title: A Tale About Sodeok-dong I
episodes.summary: Residents of a small town file a class-action lawsuit to stop the construction of a highway. Hanbada Law Firm goes up against their biggest competitor.

episodes.title: A Tale About Sodeok-dong II
episodes.summary: Taesan Law Firm keeps a step ahead of Hanbada Law Firm as conditions lean in their favor. Tae Su-mi makes an offer to Young-woo.

episodes.title: The Pied Piper
episodes.summary: A self-proclaimed leader of the children's liberation movement gets arrested for kidnapping. Young-woo tries to win Jun-ho's affection.

episodes.title: Holding Hands Can Wait
episodes.summary: A man faces jail time for taking advantage of a woman with a disability. Jun-ho's peers frown on his relationship. Min-woo pries into Young-woo's life.

episodes.title: Mr. Salt, Ms. Pepper and Attorney Soy Sauce
episodes.summary: Young-woo lands in a tricky legal position after a married couple seeks counsel to help settle a dispute involving a massive lottery win.

episodes.title: Yangtze River Dolphin
episodes.summary: Young-woo encounters Hanbada's dark side while working on a wrongful termination lawsuit. Jung Myeong-seok fears he has a target on his back.

episodes.title: The Blue Night of Jeju I
episodes.summary: A temple on Jeju Island goes to court for charging admission to the public, Young-woo meets Jun-ho's family, and Myeong-seok reflects on his life.

episodes.title: The Blue Night of Jeju II
episodes.summary: The Hanbada lawyers look for the owner of Myeong-seok's favorite noodle shop. Young-woo faces obstacles at the trial and in her relationship with Jun-ho.

episodes.title: Saying and Doing Things Not Asked
episodes.summary: When Young-woo clashes with her new supervisor during a case for a large online retailer, Myeong-seok advises her to lie low and lean on her peers.

episodes.title: Though Unusual and Peculiar
episodes.summary: Young-woo receives evidence that could make or break her case, while Min-woo changes his plans--and Jun-ho follows his heart.
